title: Netherite Vault
description: Adds netherite items to the Ominous Vault reward pool with various item chances!
body:
Just adds netherite items such as netherite block, netherite scraps, netherite sword, etc. to the Ominous Vault. Each item has it own drop chance.

## Items Chance to Drop:
- **Ancient Debris**: 10%
- **Netherite Block**: 0.3%
- **Netherite Ingot**: 2.5%
- **Netherite Scrap**: 8.0%
- **Netherite Helmet**: 2.0%
- **Netherite Chestplate**: 1.5%
- **Netherite Leggings**: 1.5%
- **Netherite Boots**: 2.0%
- **Netherite Sword**: 1.5%
- **Netherite Axe**: 1.5%
- **Netherite Pickaxe**: 2.0%
- **Netherite Spear**: 8.0%
- **Netherite Hoe**: 10%
- **Netherite Shovel**: 10%
